candidate_membership.formula: Sort path; append path, TAB, lowercase SHA-256 without prefix, LF; SHA-256 the concatenation.

required_behavior: Adopt the exact 14-claim DAG from the current registry and reject unknown, duplicate, missing, cyclic, or tampered definitions.
Bind evidence to producer, method, context, candidate, freshness, inputs, environment/tools, effects, outputs, artifacts, limitations, truth surface, and ceiling.
Reject stale, wrong-context, wrong-candidate, wrong-surface, unsupported-ceiling, self-authored, materially scored, contradictory, partial, surrogate, and reward-hacking evidence before elevation.
Require prerequisite closure and the designated independent reconciler; preserve rejected observations with reasons.
Invalidate only dependent decisions on repair/rerun and generate deterministic zero-write projections.
root_integration_state: definition-only; validator/src/lib.rs and the external public API witness remain root-owned and intentionally unchanged until independent source review passes
aggregate_note: Root independently rederived every regular-file row, total, and the six-artifact candidate digest. Worker-reported intermediate set digests used a different formula and are not authority. WorkerResult-v1 is not claimed to enforce aggregate fields.
required_no_claim_statement: This worker does not claim readiness, release, or completion.
invalidation_rule: Any artifact, membership, adopted input, dependency, context, semantic behavior, or effect change reopens this binding.
no_claim_statement: This binding does not claim public HCT-CLAIMS integration, any passed live claim, readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion.
